description: This Java class defines a custom exception called PolicyUnavailableException, which indicates that a specific policy is temporarily unavailable. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements PolicyException, providing multiple factory methods to create instances from different sources like message strings and JSON objects. The class includes an inner builder class for constructing instances fluently.

classes.name: PolicyUnavailableException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a policy is temporarily unavailable, with static factory methods and an inner builder class for instantiation.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for PolicyUnavailableException using a PolicyId.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a PolicyUnavailableException from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PolicyUnavailableException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
